calculation.description: Negative trailing three-session return; assets with recent losses receive higher scores for next-day cross-sectional return prediction. The score is computed using only data through the decision date.

decay.note: Admission and reported metrics use the required daily horizon.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC in 2020-2021, 2022-2023, 2024-2025, and 2026 subperiods; 15 tradable benchmark instruments used with conservative minimum of 8 valid names.
